reviewed_by: Claude review of per-turn project-root AGENTS.md injection for provider-backed chats
reason: Provider chats now re-read <project>/AGENTS.md on every turn and add it to the per-turn system instructions, which are rebuilt each turn and never part of the transcript that context compaction summarizes. The new tests cover: missing file, exact read and hash, symlinks allowed only inside the workspace, directory rejection, the 64 KiB cap cut on a character boundary, re-reading edits on the next turn with a changed receipt, verbatim survival across a 1,000-message compaction while compaction inputs never contain it, the context-usage estimate counting it, chats without a workspace, and an explicit refusal for an escaping symlink. Existing selections guard skill snapshots, compaction and context-limit retries, restart reconciliation, operator help, running goals, subagent resume, the tool loop and the chat API around the modified turn preparation.
exclusions: No full suites and no browser coverage: there is no UI change. Harness sessions are unchanged; they start in the project workspace and read AGENTS.md natively. Live-provider behaviour was not exercised.
